kjv: One spoon of ten [shekels] of gold
mine: one gold dish of ten shekels
note: Hebrew kaf (literally "palm") is a shallow pan or dish for incense, not a spoon in the modern sense; recurs through 7:86.
Hebrew kapporet (from kpr "atone/cover") is the lid of the ark where atonement blood was applied; "mercy seat" follows Tyndale/Luther and reads in a throne image.
